senses.en: the sport of riding waves on a surfboard

example.en: She goes surfing every weekend when the waves are good.
example.zh: 浪好的时候她每个周末都去冲浪。

senses.en: a group of people sent to represent others, for example to meet officials

example.en: A deputation of farmers met the minister to discuss the new policy.
example.zh: 一个农民代表团会见部长，讨论新政策。

senses.en: moving to the inside of something

example.en: She walked into the room.
example.zh: 她走进了房间。

senses.en: indicating a change of state

example.en: The caterpillar turned into a butterfly.
example.zh: 毛毛虫变成了蝴蝶。

senses.en: exaggerated publicity or promotion of something

example.en: The movie failed to live up to the hype.
example.zh: 这部电影辜负了铺天盖地的宣传。

senses.en: to promote something in an exaggerated way

example.en: The company hyped its new phone before the launch.
example.zh: 该公司在发布前大肆炒作新手机。

senses.en: a period of staying awake to keep watch or pray, especially at night

example.en: Friends kept a vigil outside the hospital all night.
example.zh: 朋友们在医院外守了一整夜。

senses.en: to give new life, energy, or strength to something

example.en: The new park revitalized the whole neighborhood.
example.zh: 新公园使整个街区恢复了生机。

senses.en: a large collection of written or spoken texts used for language study

example.en: The researchers built a corpus of millions of news articles.
example.zh: 研究人员建立了一个包含数百万篇新闻文章的语料库。

senses.en: the main amount of money, as opposed to income from it

example.en: They spent only the interest, leaving the corpus untouched.
example.zh: 他们只动用利息，本金保持不动。

senses.en: alcohol (informal)

example.en: He swore off booze after the holidays.
example.zh: 假期过后他戒了酒。

senses.en: to drink alcohol heavily (informal)

example.en: They spent the weekend boozing with friends.
example.zh: 他们周末和朋友豪饮作乐。

senses.en: to keep something or continue to have it

example.en: The museum retains many original features.
example.zh: 这座博物馆保留了许多原有特色。

senses.en: to remember information

example.en: She retained the main points of the talk.
example.zh: 她记住了演讲的要点。

senses.en: to pay a lawyer in advance to act for you

example.en: They retained a lawyer before the meeting.
example.zh: 他们在会面前聘请了一名律师。

senses.en: a movement of the hands or body that expresses an idea or feeling
senses.zh: 表达想法或感情的手势或身体动作

example.en: She made a gesture for us to sit down.
example.zh: 她做了个手势让我们坐下。

senses.en: an action that expresses an intention or attitude
senses.zh: 表达意图或态度的举动

example.en: Offering to help was a kind gesture.
example.zh: 主动帮忙是个善意的举动。

senses.en: to express or direct something using movements of the hands or body
senses.zh: 用手势或身体动作表达或示意

example.en: He gestured toward the empty chair.
example.zh: 他朝空椅子示意。

collocations: gesture for someone to do something

senses.en: impossible or very hard to believe

example.en: It seemed incredible that no one had noticed the mistake.
example.zh: 竟然没有人注意到这个错误，这似乎令人难以置信。

senses.en: extremely good or enjoyable

example.en: We had an incredible time at the beach.
example.zh: 我们在海滩上玩得非常开心。

senses.en: a society with complex social, political, and cultural organization
senses.zh: 文明；具有复杂社会、政治和文化组织的社会

example.en: Ancient civilizations built cities and complex systems of law.
example.zh: 古代文明建造了城市和复杂的法律体系。

senses.en: the development of organized societies, institutions, and cultural life
senses.zh: 文明的发展；社会组织与文化的发展

example.en: The history of civilization includes the development of cities and writing.
example.zh: 文明史包括城市和文字的发展。

senses.en: A particular culture or society at a given time or place.
senses.zh: 特定时期或地方的特定文化或社会。

example.en: The exhibition compares the civilizations of ancient Egypt and Mesopotamia.
example.zh: 该展览比较了古埃及和美索不达米亚的文明。

senses.en: the inside part of something, especially a building or vehicle
senses.zh: 内部；里面（尤指建筑物或车辆）

example.en: The interior of the old house was cool and dark.
example.zh: 这座老房子的内部凉爽而昏暗。

senses.en: located inside a building or object; inner

example.en: She painted the interior walls light blue.
example.zh: 她把内墙刷成了浅蓝色。

senses.en: a talk given to a group of people, especially students, to teach them about a subject

example.en: She attended a lecture on modern art.
example.zh: 她参加了一场关于现代艺术的讲座。

senses.en: to give a formal talk to a group of people, especially students

example.en: He lectures on economics at the university.
example.zh: 他在大学讲授经济学。

senses.en: to talk to someone seriously or angrily about their behavior

example.en: My father lectured me about staying out late.
example.zh: 父亲就我在外面待得太晚一事训斥了我。

senses.en: smallest in amount, extent, or degree

example.en: She has the least experience on the team.
example.zh: 她在团队中经验最少。

senses.en: to the smallest degree

example.en: He is the least likely to complain.
example.zh: 他最不可能抱怨。

senses.en: the smallest amount or thing

example.en: That is the least you can do.
example.zh: 那是你最起码能做的。

senses.en: without doubt; obviously

example.en: Clearly, the plan needs more work.
example.zh: 显然，这个计划还需要改进。

senses.en: in a way that is easy to understand

example.en: Please speak clearly during the presentation.
example.zh: 请在演示时清楚地讲话。

senses.en: in a way that is easy to see or notice

example.en: The mountain is clearly visible from here.
example.zh: 从这儿可以清晰地看到那座山。

senses.en: A person who buys or uses goods or services.

example.en: The new law aims to protect consumers from unfair practices.
example.zh: 新法律旨在保护消费者免受不公平做法侵害。

senses.en: happening repeatedly or frequently over a period of time

example.en: She was annoyed by the continual phone calls during dinner.
example.zh: 她被晚饭期间接连不断的电话惹恼了。

senses.en: continuing without stopping (sometimes considered the same as continuous)

example.en: The machine requires continual operation to keep the factory running.
example.zh: 机器需要持续运转才能维持工厂运作。

senses.en: a person who makes cloth by weaving threads together

example.en: The weaver sat at her loom all day making beautiful cloth.
example.zh: 那位织工整天坐在织布机前织着漂亮的布料。

senses.en: a bird that builds elaborately woven nests, found in Africa and Asia

example.en: Weaver birds build intricate hanging nests from grass.
example.zh: 织布鸟用草编织出精巧的悬挂巢穴。

senses.en: the mathematical operation of repeated addition, using the × sign

example.en: Children learn multiplication tables in primary school.
example.zh: 孩子们在小学学习乘法表。

senses.en: a large increase in number or amount; rapid reproduction

example.en: The multiplication of smartphones changed daily life.
example.zh: 智能手机的大量普及改变了日常生活。

senses.en: a flat, round, circular object

example.en: The moon looked like a silver disc in the sky.
example.zh: 月亮在天空中看起来像一个银色的圆盘。

senses.en: a flat round medium for storing music, data or images, such as a CD or DVD

example.en: She bought a new compact disc at the music store.
example.zh: 她在音像店买了一张新的激光唱片。

senses.en: completely; totally

example.en: The plan was utterly impossible to carry out.
example.zh: 这个计划完全无法实施。

senses.en: to break or fall apart into small pieces

example.en: The old stone wall is slowly crumbling.
example.zh: 那堵古老的石墙正在慢慢碎裂。

senses.en: to gradually stop being strong or effective

example.en: Their confidence began to crumble after the defeat.
example.zh: 失败之后他们的信心开始瓦解。

senses.en: to annoy or trouble someone repeatedly and persistently

example.en: He was harassed by constant phone calls at work.
example.zh: 他在上班时不断接到骚扰电话。

senses.en: to attack or press someone repeatedly, causing exhaustion

example.en: The army harassed the enemy's supply lines for weeks.
example.zh: 军队连续数周袭扰敌军补给线。

senses.en: in the third place; used to introduce the third point in a list

example.en: Firstly, we plan the project; secondly, we assign tasks; thirdly, we begin work.
example.zh: 第一，我们规划项目；第二，我们分配任务；第三，我们开始工作。

senses.en: to leap into the air or move forward by pushing off with the feet

example.en: She jumped over the puddle.
example.zh: 她跳过了水坑。

senses.en: to rise suddenly by a large amount

example.en: Prices jumped sharply last month.
example.zh: 上个月价格猛涨。

senses.en: to react with a sudden movement because of surprise or alarm

example.en: I jumped when the phone rang.
example.zh: 电话响时我吓了一跳。

senses.en: an act of jumping; a sudden leap or increase

example.en: The horse made a perfect jump.
example.zh: 这匹马完成了一次完美的跳跃。

senses.en: an advance fee paid to keep someone's professional services

example.en: The company pays the lawyer a monthly retainer.
example.zh: 该公司每月向律师支付聘用定金。

senses.en: a servant, especially one who has long served a family

example.en: The old family retainer had served them for decades.
example.zh: 这位老仆人已为他们家族服务了几十年。

senses.en: in a way that relates to human beings or what people can do
senses.zh: 从人的角度；在人力所及范围内

example.en: It is humanly impossible to finish all this work in one day.
example.zh: 在人力范围内，一天之内完成所有这些工作是不可能的。

senses.en: a wide road for fast traffic, especially in North America

example.en: Traffic on the expressway was heavy this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上高速公路上车流很大。

senses.en: something done as a required custom, though it may lack real importance

example.en: Signing the papers was just a formality.
example.zh: 签这些文件只是走个形式。

senses.en: strict observation of formal customs or etiquette

example.en: There was too much formality at the dinner.
example.zh: 晚宴上礼节太繁重了。

senses.en: a tall African animal with a very long neck and a spotted coat

example.en: The giraffe used its long neck to reach leaves high in the tree.
example.zh: 长颈鹿用长脖子够到了树高处的叶子。

senses.en: the direction where the sun rises

example.en: The sun rises in the east.
example.zh: 太阳从东方升起。

senses.en: in or from the east

example.en: The east side of the city is quieter.
example.zh: 城市的东侧更安静。

senses.en: toward the east

example.en: They drove east for two hours.
example.zh: 他们向东开了两个小时。

senses.en: to join two or more things together to form one group or whole

example.en: The two schools will combine their music programs next year.
example.zh: 这两所学校明年将合并他们的音乐课程。

senses.en: to mix things together

example.en: Combine the flour and sugar before adding the eggs.
example.zh: 加入鸡蛋前，先把面粉和糖混合。

senses.en: a large machine that cuts and threshes grain

example.en: The farmer drove the combine across the wheat field.
example.zh: 农民开着联合收割机穿过麦田。

senses.en: from a particular time in the past until a later time or now
senses.zh: 自…以来（延续至某一时刻或现在）

example.en: I have lived here since 2019.
example.zh: 我从2019年起就住在这里。

senses.en: because; for the reason that

example.en: Since it's raining, we'll stay inside.
example.zh: 因为在下雨，我们将待在室内。

senses.en: from the time when

example.en: She has been smiling since she arrived.
example.zh: 她到达后一直面带微笑。

senses.en: from a past time until now

example.en: He left home in 2010 and hasn't returned since.
example.zh: 他2010年离家，此后一直未归。

senses.en: the removal of excess water or liquid from a place

example.en: The drainage system in the city was upgraded last year.
example.zh: 这座城市的排水系统去年进行了升级。

senses.en: medical removal of fluid from a wound or body part

example.en: The surgeon placed a tube for drainage of the wound.
example.zh: 外科医生放置了一根管子用于伤口引流。

senses.en: the process of taking in a substance, liquid, or energy

example.en: Plants absorb water through their roots by absorption.
example.zh: 植物通过吸收作用经根部吸收水分。

senses.en: complete attention or concentration on something

example.en: She read the novel with complete absorption.
example.zh: 她全神贯注地读这本小说。

senses.en: the regular beat of the heart

example.en: The doctor listened to the baby's heartbeat.
example.zh: 医生听了听婴儿的心跳。

senses.en: a very short moment of time

example.en: In a heartbeat, the opportunity was gone.
example.zh: 一瞬间，机会就没了。

senses.en: sad, gloomy, or of very poor quality

example.en: The team's performance this season has been dismal.
example.zh: 球队本赛季的表现很糟糕。

senses.en: relating to the time when someone's character or abilities are developing
senses.zh: 形成期的；影响性格发展的

example.en: Those years abroad were a formative experience for her.
example.zh: 在国外的那几年对她是一段影响深远的经历。

senses.en: without a clear purpose or direction

example.en: They spent an aimless afternoon wandering around town.
example.zh: 他们漫无目的地在镇上逛了一个下午。

senses.en: the transfer of pollen from the anther to the stigma of a flower, enabling fertilization

example.en: Bees play a vital role in the pollination of crops.
example.zh: 蜜蜂在农作物授粉中起着重要作用。

senses.en: the 100th anniversary of an event, or its celebration (mainly British English)

example.en: The town marked the centenary of its founding with a parade.
example.zh: 小镇以游行庆祝建镇一百周年。

senses.en: relating to a period of 100 years

example.en: The centenary celebrations lasted all week.
example.zh: 百周年庆祝活动持续了整周。

senses.en: a pot for brewing or serving coffee

example.en: She rinsed the coffeepot after breakfast.
example.zh: 她早餐后把咖啡壶冲洗干净。

senses.en: to jump suddenly on prey or on something, to seize it

example.en: The cat pounced on the toy mouse.
example.zh: 猫猛扑向那只玩具老鼠。

senses.en: a sudden leap or jump made to seize something

example.en: The owl's pounce caught the vole by surprise.
example.zh: 猫头鹰的猛扑让田鼠措手不及。

senses.en: having an unfriendly or threatening appearance; unwelcoming
senses.zh: 严峻的；令人生畏的；难亲近的

example.en: The castle looked dark and forbidding in the rain.
example.zh: 雨中的城堡显得阴森而令人生畏。

senses.en: to release air or gas from something so it becomes smaller or limp

example.en: He deflated the air mattress after the trip.
example.zh: 旅行结束后他给充气床垫放了气。

senses.en: to make someone feel less confident or proud, or to cause prices or expectations to fall
senses.zh: 使泄气；使（物价、期望）下降

example.en: The harsh criticism deflated her confidence.
example.zh: 严厉的批评使她的信心受挫。

senses.en: selfless concern for the well-being of others

example.en: Her altruism led her to volunteer at the shelter every week.
example.zh: 她的利他精神让她每周都去收容所做志愿者。
